reviews.title: Fast, reliable, and great for everyday use
reviews.comment: I have been using this SSD in my build and it has been holding up to date. It all seems a lot quicker - booting up, loading games and the overall use are much smoother than a regular drive. It has a maximum speed of approximately 3,200 MB/s read speed, which is sufficient to use daily and play games. It was so easy to install, only a single screw is needed. It is cool and I have not had any performance or reliability problems.
reviews.author: James

reviews.title: Decent drive
reviews.comment: This M.2 Drive installed and worked well.  The price for it was competitive and it arrived on the promised date.  So far no issues.
reviews.author: Norman Kellerman

reviews.title: Easy install, works great!
reviews.comment: This product was super easy to install.  I recommend have a magnetic tip screwdriver.  It took less than 5 minutes to pull off the side of the PC and pop this NVME card in.  The computer recognized it right away and we were off and running.  Good price for a 1TB device!
reviews.author: B Rizzle

reviews.title: Fast USB-C connection
reviews.comment: I put this drive in an Asus case for portability. Encryption does not slow it down. Awesome drive. Highly recommend this drive.
reviews.author: KB
